.. py:function:: main() -> None

   Segmentation tools.


.. py:function:: _mouse_brain_runner(image, mask=None, *, mode: str, modality: str, which_parcellation: str, do_n4: bool, binarize: bool, return_isotropic_output: bool, fix_spacing: bool, verbose: bool)

   Run ANTsPyNet mouse-brain extraction or parcellation on *image* with the parsed CLI parameters.


.. py:function:: cmd_mouse_brain(input_path: pathlib.Path, output_path: pathlib.Path, mask_path: pathlib.Path | None, backend: str, submit: str, emit_script: pathlib.Path | None, direct_submit: bool, no_remote: bool, dry_run: bool, mode: str, modality: str, which_parcellation: str, do_n4: bool, fix_spacing: bool, binarize: bool, return_isotropic_output: bool, verbose: bool) -> None

   Mouse brain extraction / parcellation (ANTsPyNet).


.. py:function:: _brain_extraction_runner(image, mask=None, *, modality: str, image2_path: str | None, verbose: bool)

   Run ANTsPyNet brain extraction on *image*, using a second co-registered volume from
   *image2_path* when the modality requires it (e.g. ``t1t2infant``); *mask* is unused.


.. py:function:: cmd_brain_extraction(input_path: pathlib.Path, output_path: pathlib.Path, backend: str, submit: str, emit_script: pathlib.Path | None, direct_submit: bool, no_remote: bool, dry_run: bool, modality: str, image2_path: pathlib.Path | None, verbose: bool) -> None

   Multi-modal brain extraction (ANTsPyNet).


.. py:function:: _mra_runner(image, mask=None, *, prediction_batch_size: int, patch_stride_length: int, verbose: bool)

   Run ANTsPyNet MRA-TOF vessel segmentation on *image* with the parsed CLI parameters.


.. py:function:: cmd_mra_vessel(input_path: pathlib.Path, output_path: pathlib.Path, mask_path: pathlib.Path | None, backend: str, submit: str, emit_script: pathlib.Path | None, direct_submit: bool, no_remote: bool, dry_run: bool, prediction_batch_size: int, patch_stride_length: int, verbose: bool) -> None

   MRA-TOF vessel segmentation (ANTsPyNet probability map).


.. py:function:: _dkt_runner(image, mask=None, *, do_preprocessing: bool, do_lobar_parcellation: bool, do_denoising: bool, version: int, verbose: bool)

   Run ANTsPyNet Desikan-Killiany-Tourville cortical parcellation on *image*; *mask* is unused.


.. py:function:: cmd_dkt(input_path: pathlib.Path, output_path: pathlib.Path, backend: str, submit: str, emit_script: pathlib.Path | None, direct_submit: bool, no_remote: bool, dry_run: bool, preprocessing: bool, do_lobar_parcellation: bool, denoising: bool, version: int, verbose: bool) -> None

   Desikan-Killiany-Tourville cortical parcellation (ANTsPyNet).


.. py:function:: _parse_sigmas(text: str | None) -> tuple[float, Ellipsis]

   Parse a comma/semicolon-separated Frangi sigma list from *text*, or the default sigmas if unset.


.. py:function:: cmd_blood_flood(input_path: pathlib.Path, output_path: pathlib.Path, backend: str, submit: str, emit_script: pathlib.Path | None, direct_submit: bool, no_remote: bool, dry_run: bool, mode: str, markers_path: pathlib.Path | None, mask_path: pathlib.Path | None, barrier_path: pathlib.Path | None, frangi_sigmas: str | None, hyst_low_factor: float, hyst_high_factor: float, thicken_iter: int, thin_vesselness_percentile: float, min_cc_voxels: int, connectivity: int, save_tree: pathlib.Path | None) -> None

   Frangi → hysteresis vessel tree; expand from markers or segment from scratch.
